fulfillment.done: Done: they have access to everything now.
fulfillment.still_missing: Some product still has no access. Please try again in a few minutes.

actions.title: What do you want to do?
actions.none: There is nothing left to do with this order.

late_warning.expired: This order is expired. Only confirm it if the money arrived.
late_warning.rejected: This order is rejected. Only confirm it if the money arrived.
late_warning.cancelled: This order is cancelled. Only confirm it if the money arrived.

confirm_form.check_bank: Before confirming, check in your bank that you received **Bs. {{amount}}**.
confirm_form.reference_hint: Copy it from the receipt or your bank, for example 001234567890. Spaces, dots and hyphens are removed.
confirm_form.reference_invalid: The reference must have 4 to 30 letters or digits.
confirm_form.note_hint: For example: paid from her husband's account.
confirm_form.note_too_long: The note can have up to {{max}} characters.
confirm_form.reused_title: That reference was already used in another paid order
confirm_form.reused_body: Orders with that reference: {{codes}}. If it really is a different payment, you can confirm it anyway.
confirm_form.success_unnamed: Payment confirmed. They have access now.

reject_form.intro: Use it when the payment didn't arrive or doesn't match the order.
reject_form.reason_hint: For example: we couldn't find the payment in the bank. The buyer will see it in their order and in the email, if we send it.
reject_form.reason_invalid: Write a reason of 3 to 300 characters.
reject_form.success_notified: Order rejected. We let them know by email.

void_form.warning: Removes access to everything in this order.
void_form.intro: Only use it if you marked it as paid by mistake.
void_form.reason_hint: It stays in the order. We don't email the buyer.
void_form.reason_invalid: Write a reason of 3 to 300 characters.
void_form.success: Order voided. They no longer have access to what it included.

pago_movil.title: Pago Móvil
pago_movil.tagline: Get paid in bolivars at the day's BCV rate.
pago_movil.save_error: We couldn't save Pago Móvil. Please try again.
pago_movil.load_error: We couldn't load the Pago Móvil details.
pago_movil.fix_fields: Check the fields marked in red.
pago_movil.help: Buyers will see these details, the amount in bolivars and a button to send you the receipt by WhatsApp. You confirm each payment in Orders.
pago_movil.holder_hint: As it appears at the bank.
pago_movil.whatsapp_hint: With the country code, for example 58 424 8824634. The receipts will arrive there.
pago_movil.whatsapp_country: The country code is missing (58 for Venezuela)
pago_movil.whatsapp_error: Write the WhatsApp number with the country code, for example 58 424 8824634.
pago_movil.instructions_hint: For example: write the order number in the payment description.
pago_movil.window_hint: If they don't pay in time, the order expires by itself.
pago_movil.window_error: The time limit must be between 1 and 168 hours.
pago_movil.fx_manual_hint: For example 887,30. Used instead of the BCV rate while the manual rate is chosen.
pago_movil.rate_error: Write the rate in Bs. per dollar, for example 887,30.
pago_movil.rate_ambiguous: Write the rate with 2 decimals (for example 887,30) so it isn't read as thousands.
pago_movil.rate_preview: It will be saved as {{rate}} Bs. per US$
pago_movil.rate_far: This rate is more than 50 % away from today's BCV rate ({{bcv}} Bs. per US$). Check that it is written correctly.
pago_movil.too_long: It can have up to {{max}} characters.
pago_movil.notify_hint: We write to this address every time a new order arrives.
pago_movil.required_to_enable: This is needed to turn Pago Móvil on.
pago_movil.fx_error_hint: Meanwhile, you can choose the manual rate and type it yourself.
